clause_title: Standard German NDA: Governing Law
clause_text:
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Federal
Republic of Germany.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Definition of Affiliate
clause_text:
"Affiliate" means, with respect to any Party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is
controlled by, or is under common control with such Party, where "control" means the
possession, directly or indirectly, of the power to direct or cause the direction of the
management and policies of such entity, whether through ownership of voting securities, by
contract or otherwise.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Definition of Confidential Information
clause_text:
"Confidential Information" means all information, data, materials, and documentation of any
kind, whether written, oral, electronic, visual, or in any other form, that is disclosed by the
Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, including but not limited to technical data, trade secrets,
know-how, research, product plans, products, services, customers, customer lists, markets,
software, developments, inventions, processes, formulas, technology, designs, drawings,
engineering, hardware configuration information, marketing, finances, or other business
information.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Definition of Disclosing Party
clause_text:
"Disclosing Party" means the Party disclosing Confidential Information under this Agreement,
as identified in the Parties section above.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Definition of Effective Date
clause_text: "Effective Date" means [EFFECTIVE DATE] .

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Definition of Purpose
clause_text: "Purpose" means [PURPOSE OF DISCLOSURE] .

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Definition of Receiving Party
clause_text:
"Receiving Party" means the Party receiving Confidential Information under this Agreement,
as identified in the Parties section above.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Definition of Representatives
clause_text:
"Representatives" means, with respect to any Party, its directors, officers, employees, agents,
advisors, consultants, and professional advisers who have a legitimate need to know the
Confidential Information for the Purpose and who are bound by confidentiality obligations no
less restrictive than those contained in this Agreement.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Definition of Third Party
clause_text:
"Third Party" means any person or entity other than the Disclosing Party, the Receiving Party,
and their respective Affiliates and Representatives.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Confidential Information
clause_text:
For the purposes of this Agreement, 'Confidential Information' means any and all non-public,
proprietary, or confidential information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party,
whether orally, in writing, electronically, or in any other form, including but not limited to:
technical data, research, inventions, processes, algorithms, software, source code, object code,
and know-how;
business information, including strategies, plans, financial information, pricing, customer lists,
supplier information, and market analyses;
any information concerning the business, affairs, customers, clients, suppliers, plans, intentions,
or market opportunities of the Disclosing Party;
any analyses, compilations, studies, or other documents prepared by the Receiving Party that
contain or reflect Confidential Information.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Confidential Information Identification
clause_text:
Confidential Information shall be deemed to include information that has been marked or
identified as 'confidential,' 'proprietary,' or with a similar designation, as well as information that
would reasonably be understood to be confidential given the nature of the information and the
circumstances of disclosure.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Exclusions from Confidential Information
Standard German NDA: Obligations of Receiving Party
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall hold all Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall not
disclose any Confidential Information to any Third Party without the prior written consent of the
Disclosing Party.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Purpose of Use
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall use the Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and shall not
use such information for any other purpose whatsoever.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Limited Access to Confidential Information
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall limit access to Confidential Information to those of its Representatives
who have a legitimate need to know such information for the Purpose and who have been
informed of the confidential nature of such information.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Confidentiality Obligations of Representatives
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall ensure that all Representatives who have access to Confidential
Information are bound by confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than those contained in
this Agreement.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Restrictions on Copying and Reproduction
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall not copy, reproduce, or create derivative works from any Confidential
Information except to the extent reasonably necessary for the Purpose.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Reverse Engineering Prohibition
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall not reverse engineer, disassemble, or decompile any Confidential
Information, including but not limited to any software, technical data, or proprietary processes
disclosed by the Disclosing Party.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Notification of Unauthorized Disclosure
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall immediately notify the Disclosing Party in writing upon becoming
aware of any unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information and shall cooperate
with the Disclosing Party in any efforts to prevent or remedy such breach.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Permitted Disclosures - Prior Knowledge
Standard German NDA: Permitted Disclosures - Legal Requirement
Standard German NDA: Permitted Disclosures - To Representatives
clause_text:
The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to its Representatives who have a
legitimate need to know such information for the Purpose, provided that such Representatives
are bound by confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than those contained herein.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Permitted Disclosures - With Consent
clause_text:
The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information with the prior written consent of the
Disclosing Party, subject to any conditions specified in such consent.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: StaStandard German NDA:rd of Care
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall protect and safeguard the Confidential Information using the same
degree of care that it uses to protect its own confidential and proprietary information, but in no
event less than reasonable care.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Prevention of Unauthorized Disclosure
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall take all reasonable precautions to prevent any unauthorized
disclosure, publication, or dissemination of the Confidential Information.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Representatives' Awareness of Confidentiality
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall ensure that its Representatives who have access to the Confidential
Information are informed of the confidential nature of such information and are bound by
confidentiality obligations at least as restrictive as those contained in this Agreement.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Liability for Representatives' Breach
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall be liable for any breach of this Agreement by its Representatives as if
such breach had been committed by the Receiving Party itself.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Notification of Unauthorized Use or Disclosure
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall immediately notify the Disclosing Party in writing upon becoming
aware of any unauthorized use or disclosure of the Confidential Information.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Return or Destruction of Information
clause_text:
Upon written request by the Disclosing Party, or upon termination or expiration of this
Agreement, the Receiving Party shall promptly return to the Disclosing Party all documents,
materials, and other tangible items containing or representing Confidential Information.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Destruction of Copies
clause_text:
In addition to the return obligation under clause 6.1, the Receiving Party shall destroy all copies,
extracts, summaries, analyses, and other materials in any form that contain or are derived from
Confidential Information, including electronic copies stored on computers, servers, or other
storage media.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Secure Destruction
clause_text:
The destruction required under clause 6.2 shall be carried out in a secure manner that prevents
recovery or reconstruction of the Confidential Information.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Certification of Return/Destruction
clause_text:
Within thirty (30) days of completion of the return and destruction obligations, the Receiving
Party shall provide written certification to the Disclosing Party confirming that all Confidential
Information has been returned or destroyed in accordance with this clause 6.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Exception for Legally Required Copies
clause_text:
Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Receiving Party may retain copies of Confidential Information
to the extent required by applicable law or regulation, provided that such retained information
remains subject to the confidentiality obligations of this Agreement.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Application to Representatives
clause_text:
The obligations set forth in this clause 6 shall also apply to all Representatives of the Receiving
Party who have had access to Confidential Information.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: No License or Rights Granted
clause_text:
Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as granting, by implication, estoppel or otherwise,
any license or right under any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret or other intellectual
property right of the Disclosing Party.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: No Representation or Warranty
clause_text:
The disclosure of Confidential Information under this Agreement shall not constitute any
representation, warranty, assurance, guarantee or inducement by the Disclosing Party of any
kind with respect to the Confidential Information, including without limitation regarding its
accuracy, completeness, or freedom from defect.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Limited Rights
clause_text:
No rights or licenses are granted to the Receiving Party other than the limited right to evaluate
the Confidential Information solely for the Purpose as defined herein.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Ownership of Intellectual Property
clause_text:
The Receiving Party acknowledges that any intellectual property rights in the Confidential
Information remain the exclusive property of the Disclosing Party or its licensors.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Term and Termination
clause_text:
This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue in force for a period of
three (3) years , unless terminated earlier in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Termination on Notice
clause_text:
Either Party may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving thirty (30) days prior written
notice to the other Party.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Survival of Obligations
clause_text:
The obligations of the Receiving Party under this Agreement shall survive termination of this
Agreement and shall continue for a period of five (5) years from the date of termination, or until
such time as the Confidential Information becomes publicly available through no breach of this
Agreement by the Receiving Party, whichever occurs first.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Survival of Specific Sections
clause_text:
Upon termination of this Agreement, the provisions of Sections 6 (Return or Destruction of
Information), 9 (Remedies and Injunctive Relief), 10 (Governing Law and Jurisdiction), and 11
(Severability) shall survive and remain in full force and effect.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Liability Before Termination
clause_text:
Termination of this Agreement shall not relieve either Party of any liability for breach of this
Agreement occurring prior to such termination.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Acknowledgement of Irreparable Harm
clause_text:
The Receiving Party acknowledges that any breach of this Agreement may cause irreparable
harm to the Disclosing Party for which monetary damages would be inadequate compensation.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Injunctive Relief
clause_text:
In the event of an actual or threatened breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party, the
Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek immediate injunctive relief and other equitable
remedies from any court of competent jurisdiction without the necessity of proving actual standard damages or posting a bond.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Injunctive Relief Additional
clause_text:
The right to seek injunctive relief shall be in addition to, and not in lieu of, any other remedies
available to the Disclosing Party at law or in equity, including monetary damages.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Costs and Expenses
clause_text:
The Receiving Party shall be liable for all costs and expenses, including reasonable attorney's
fees, incurred by the Disclosing Party in enforcing this Agreement or in obtaining any remedy for
breach thereof.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Survival of Remedies
clause_text: The remedies set forth in this Section 9 shall survive termination of this Agreement.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Governing Law
clause_text:
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Federal
Republic of Germany.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Jurisdiction
clause_text:
Any dispute, controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach,
termination or invalidity thereof, shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent
courts of [CITY] , Germany.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Submission to Jurisdiction
clause_text:
The Parties hereby irrevocably submit to the jurisdiction of such courts and waive any objection
to proceedings in such courts on the grounds of venue or on the grounds that the proceedings
have been brought in an inconvenient forum.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Interim Relief
clause_text:
This choice of law and jurisdiction shall not prevent either Party from seeking interim or
provisional relief in any jurisdiction where assets of the other Party may be found.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Severability
clause_text:
If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable by a court of
competent jurisdiction, such provision shall be deemed severed from this Agreement and the
validity, legality and enforceability of the remaining provisions shall not be affected or impaired
thereby.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Replacement of Invalid Provision
clause_text:
In the event that any provision is deemed invalid, illegal or unenforceable, the Parties shall
negotiate in good faith to replace such provision with a valid, legal and enforceable provision
that most closely reflects the original intent of the Parties.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Termination due to Severability
clause_text:
If the severed provision is essential to the performance of this Agreement such that its removal
would fuStandard German NDA:mentally alter the nature or purpose of this Agreement, either Party may terminate
this Agreement upon thirty (30) days' written notice to the other Party.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Entire Agreement
clause_text:
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the
subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, or agreements
relating to such subject matter, whether written or oral.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: Amendment in Writing
clause_text:
No amendment, modification, or waiver of any provision of this Agreement shall be effective
unless made in writing and signed by both Parties.

clause_title: Standard German NDA: No Waiver
clause_text:
Any waiver of a breach of any provision of this Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of any
other breach of the same or any other provision.
